ننكشف (form VII)
# نَنْكَشِفُ (nankašifu) /nan.ka.ʃi.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْكَشَفَ (inkašafa)
# نَنْكَشِفَ (nankašifa) /nan.ka.ʃi.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْكَشَفَ (inkašafa)
# نَنْكَشِفْ (nankašif) /nan.ka.ʃif/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْكَشَفَ (inkašafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
